_doc: THE GRAMMAR OF THE SPINE (Palle, 2026-11-09: "make a grammar that can work throughout the whole spine"). AUTHORED. One vocabulary for the acts that turn one form into the next, from the point (genesis) to the post-crisis floors. A transition card (commons/modular/terms.json, a term's `card`) names ONE of these operations in `op`; the term expressions and builds speak older dialects, and `aliases` say which of their words mean which operation, so the cards, the expressions and the builds are read as one language without rewriting the expressions (the vending machines and four tools show them). Each operation has a KIND - Palle's rule 'extension is body, association is name' (2026-11-08) splits the two that matter most - and raises an AXIS by a LEVEL. The EARNED rule (Palle, 2026-11-08: each floor only what it has earned): a work may use an operation only after the card that introduces it stands earlier in the artifact timeline, and an axis level n only after level n-1. `spine` names each spine sequence's ROOT card: the first transition met on that sequence's floors. Check: python tools/grammar.py check. Drafted entries say so in their card's `said` until Palle's own words replace them.

kinds.form: changes the geometry: how many dimensions, what is inside, what closes
kinds.body: changes what the physics engine computes: it collides, has mass, fits a hand, is held by another part (Palle: extension is body)
kinds.name: changes what the work is called and which one it is, not what the engine computes (Palle: association is name)
kinds.number: changes how many: copies, counts, addresses
kinds.time: makes a value a function of time
kinds.chance: the next value is drawn, not computed
kinds.rule: a rule acts on states, or on its own results
kinds.relation: which is joined to which, without a length

form: a surface out of a field
body: a hand: it can be taken
name: a familiar name, one configuration of a form
a name given to people by a decision
path: the trace a moving point leaves
place: where it is, which way, how big
drive: position as a function of time
a wave: time and space at once
each body driven by its neighbours
joint: many ties at once: a body that bends and comes back
parts: an assemblage: many kinds of part
the operations as parts of one formula
many: repetition by a symmetry: a pattern
direction: a length with a direction: it can push
rest: moving until nothing changes: the form is where it stops
chance: chance at every point of space
chance kept where a rule allows it
light: a rule for every pixel at once
rule: a rule applied to its own result
react: a decision: inputs become an output
a decision whose rule its results change
measure: a reading: parts in a row by a measure

extension.adds: a body: the form is in the way

trail.adds: the path a moving point leaves

closure.adds: an inside: a face, a solid

times.adds: copies placed by a turn, a mirror, a shift

step.adds: mass and time: it falls, swings, rests

hand.adds: it fits a hand: it can be taken

transform.adds: a new place, the form unchanged

drive.adds: a value that is a function of time

assemblage.adds: several kinds of part become one thing

sort.adds: parts in a row by a measure

field.adds: a value at every point of space

recurse.adds: a rule applied to its own result

rewrite.adds: a sentence that rewrites itself, drawn

boolean.adds: two solids combined by their insides

connect.adds: which joins which, without a length

reflect.adds: the system turned on its own axioms

spine.note: no floor of its own in the Void tower (its Change_Choreography stands among the forces floors) - no root card until it has one
